tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Every section sits on it; never tint it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Recessed areas on bg: tag fills, nav track, code wells.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and floating UI (ProjectCard, NowCard, nav hover pill). Pair with the lift shadow.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: card borders at rest, section dividers, the timeline track. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (ghost button, inputs) and resting underlines. Holds 3:1 on bg, surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body copy on bg, surface and surface-raised. Also the active nav pill fill (text on it is bg).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: leads, card descriptions, timeline bodies, eyebrows. 7:1+ on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Metadata only: years, indices, marquee words at rest. 4.5:1+ on bg, surface and surface-raised; never for paragraphs.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one hot colour (sodium streetlight). Primary button, section indices, the cursor, progress fills, hover wipes. Text use only 19px+ or mono labels; on bg it reads 7:1 at night and 4.6:1 by day. One signal moment per screen.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind signal marks: card spotlight, equalizer well, signal tags (text on it is ink).

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a signal fill (7:1 at night, 5.2:1 by day).

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Cool counterweight: focus rings, inline links in prose, sky tags. 5.4:1+ on every ground in both themes.

tokens.name: sky-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind sky marks (sky tags). Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: on-sky
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a sky fill.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: State only: the pulsing dot for something live or in active development. Always beside a word (StatusBadge); never decoration.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The hero name only. One per page. Drops to 22vw under 720px.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Project names on cards, big statements inside a section.

styles.name: body-l
styles.usage: Hero lead, section kickers, the About paragraph.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Platforma do oglądania anime, rozwijana od marca 2025.
styles.usage: Default copy: card descriptions, timeline bodies.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, indices, status words, years. Set uppercase in CSS.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code, stack tags, the nav wordmark.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline nudges: icon-to-text inside tags.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Status dot to word; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button icon gap; tag inline padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap between siblings; mobile gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Button inline padding; gaps inside cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Card padding; desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section header to content; timeline indent.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Hero top padding.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop (space-24 on mobile).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small marks: equalizer bars, kbd, code wells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inner wells and media inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and the NowCard.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags, the nav and its sliding pill.

tokens.name: lift
tokens.usage: Floating surfaces: cards, nav, NowCard.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Hovered primary button and the hovered project card. Signal only.

duration.note: Motion is part of the brand. Every transition uses one of these; nothing is slower than dur-epic.

tokens.name: dur-instant
tokens.usage: Colour and opacity on press.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover colour and border changes.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Text roll, arrow swap, nav pill slide, magnetic return.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Reveals, CTA wipe, timeline fill.

tokens.name: dur-epic
tokens.usage: Headline letter rise; the hero only gets this.

easing.note: Fast out, long settle. Springs only for things that follow the pointer.

tokens.name: ease-out-expo
tokens.usage: Default for every entrance, wipe and roll.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Pointer-driven motion with a small overshoot: magnetic buttons, nav pill, CTA orb.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Loops that breathe: equalizer, status pulse.
